subject: POC scope rebaseline - add document ingestion use case
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call (POC plan)

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC with your team next week.

Summary of outcomes from the call:
- Goal: validate Redwood's inference runtime for two primary pipelines: chat-based support summarization and search re-ranking.
- Success criteria (initial):
  - Latency: 95th percentile response < 500ms for single-turn chat at 512 tokens
  - Cost: under $0.012/token equivalent for production-like throughput
  - Quality: human eval score >= 85% on a 50-sample prompt set provided by Acme
- Scope: one month POC, hosted sandbox, sample dataset + 5k documents for retrieval tests

Proposed next steps:
1) We share a short SOW + evaluation plan by EOD tomorrow (attached draft).
2) You provide the 50 evaluation prompts and a sample of the dataset (1k docs) by Friday.
3) Kickoff call: Monday 11/16 to finalize telemetry and access.

I've attached a draft success-criteria spreadsheet and evaluation plan to this thread (poc_success_criteria_v2.xlsx). Rishi will support infra/access and Camila (cc) will be your CSM once we sign the SOW.

If anything above looks off, flag and I will update. Otherwise we will treat this as the baseline and lock timelines.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: poc_success_criteria_v2.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call (POC plan)

Thanks Marissa  this is a helpful summary. Two quick items from our side after chatting with the engineering leadership this morning:

1) Additional use case: we'd like to include a small document ingestion pipeline during the POC. That pipeline would ingest ~10k docs (PDFs + DOCX) and validate retrieval + summarization latency/accuracy. This wasn't in our original plan but is a hard requirement for the product team.
2) Success criteria update: for the document use case, we want recall@10 >= 0.85 on a 500-query sample and extractive summary ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on a 200-sample subset.

If we add this, we'll likely need an extra week on the timeline and additional Redwood support on ingestion and chunking recommendations. Can you re-baseline and share an updated plan + timeline?

Also CCing Emily (product) who will own the doc samples and evaluation queries.

- Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product, AcmeCorp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call (POC plan)

Thanks Alex  great context and understood. We can absolutely add document ingestion as a scoped use case. Proposed re-baseline below (high level):

Revised scope and success criteria (high level):
- Add use case: Document ingestion (PDF/DOCX) -> vector store retrieval -> extractive/abstractive summarization.
- Document use case success criteria: recall@10 >= 0.85 (500 queries), ROUGE-L >= 0.45 (200 sample summaries).
- Existing chat/search criteria remain the same.

Timeline impact:
- Add 1 week to POC for ingestion, pre-processing, and evaluation runs. New total: 5 weeks.
- Updated kickoff: Monday 11/23 (one-week prep to get doc samples + infra).

Ownership and asks:
- Acme: provide 10k doc sample + 500 eval queries + 200 summary gold-set by 11/20. (Emily to coordinate)
- Redwood: provide ingestion templates, chunking recommendations, and a short runbook for the vector store integration by 11/19.
- Redwood CSM (Camila) to schedule weekly check-ins and ensure telemetry is visible.

I attached a short scope-change summary (poc_scope_change_summary.pdf) and updated the success criteria spreadsheet. If that looks acceptable I'll send a formal SOW addendum and a revised evaluation plan.

Would you be available for a 30-min rebaseline call on Friday 11/13 at 10am PT? If so I'll book and send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa

---
Attachment: poc_scope_change_summary.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call (POC plan)

Hi Alex  happy to take point on the CSM side. Quick notes from an operations perspective:

- Ingestion support: Redwood can provide a lightweight ingestion pipeline (S3 drop + ingestion lambda) and recommended chunking parameters. We will also provide a small sample notebook for PDF/DOCX parsing.
- Resource impact: adding the ingestion use case requires one additional engineer for the first two weeks of the POC to help with on-call ingestion troubleshooting. That is covered under the POC engagement.
- Timeline: 11/23 kickoff is fine from our side, but we do need the doc samples by 11/20 to meet the evaluation window.

I've created an internal Jira ticket and linked it: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-128.

I'll send the calendar invite for Friday 11/13 10am PT; please accept if that works.

Thanks 
Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call (POC plan)

Marissa / Camila 

Thanks, that all looks good. Friday 10am PT works for a short rebaseline call  I'll accept the invite. Emily will start assembling the 10k doc sample and the evaluation queries and aim to share by 11/19 to give a little buffer.

One ask: can you include a short section in the SOW addendum outlining the handling of PII in ingested docs and a retention policy for the sandbox? That will help our security/compliance reviewers sign off quickly.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here  looking forward to the kickoff.

- Alex
